Dear [Hiring Manager's Name],  

I’ve collaborated with Kunal Bhatt on two cross-functional projects at GlobalTech Solutions Inc., where he served as a Data Scientist. As a peer in a small FAANG team, I’ve observed his consistent ability to translate complex business problems into actionable insights without relying on flashy tools.  

Kunal’s strength lies in his methodical approach to data analysis and his knack for identifying subtle patterns that others overlook. For instance, during a customer churn initiative, he flagged an overlooked correlation between service request frequency and retention rates. His analysis led to a 12% improvement in retention metrics by refining support protocols. He also excels at distilling technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations—a skill that’s critical in aligning data-driven decisions with business goals.  

One standout moment was when he spearheaded a real-time monitoring system for infrastructure costs. By re-engineering data pipelines to aggregate and visualize spending trends, his team reduced cloud expenditure by $180K annually. This required meticulous attention to detail and an ability to balance technical rigor with stakeholder priorities.  

Kunal is a reliable collaborator who consistently meets deadlines and adapts to shifting priorities. His work ethic is marked by intellectual curiosity and a commitment to precision. I’d recommend him without hesitation for any role requiring analytical depth and operational impact.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Full Name]
